newsitem.title: UK: Imperial Tobacco down as Laing rates "sell".
newsitem.headline: Imperial Tobacco down as Laing rates "sell".

text.p: Shares in Imperial Tobacco Plc dropped on Wednesday after analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing issued a "sell" rating on the stock, traders said.
The shares, which reached a peak of 438p on October 3 -- the day after being spun off from conglomerate Hanson Plc -- were down 4-1/2p at 386-1/2 by 1136 GMT.

Sources said Laing's negative view stemmed from concerns that the company may undertake an ill-advised international expansion. "The worry is it will try to do too much," said one. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
